# Edooqoo — LLMs Reference

> AI-powered ecosystem for English tutors. 1-on-1 adult education. Full docs: docs/llm-context.md

## Application Architecture
- SPA: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3 + TypeScript 5 + shadcn/ui
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage)
- Payments: Stripe (subscriptions + one-time tokens)
- AI: Gemini 2.5 Flash (worksheet generation), verify-open-answers (AI grading)
- Media: generate-audio (TTS), generate-image (AI images), transcribe-audio
- Calendar: Google Calendar API (teacher + student sync)
- 47 pages, 53 hooks, 49 edge functions

## Feature Modules

### Worksheet Generation Engine
- 29 exercise types (20 basic + 5 audio + 4 picture), CEFR A1-C2
- Gemini 2.5 Flash, streaming SSE, 200K char ai_response
- Post-gen: processExercises, deepFixTextObjects, media generation
- Each item carries nano_skill: {name, confidence, reason} for DSLM
- Key: useWorksheetGeneration, generateWorksheet edge fn, WorksheetForm/
- RAG: worksheet generator, AI worksheets, ESL materials, CEFR exercises

### Homework System
- Assign → student completes online → AI grades open-ended (verify-open-answers)
- homework_assignments, homework_student_answers, homework_teacher_corrections tables
- Deadline + email reminders, completion tracking, teacher review
- Key: useInteractiveHomework, HomeworkReviewPage, send-homework-email
- RAG: homework grading, AI evaluation, open-ended assessment

### Flashcards & Spaced Repetition
- SM-2 algorithm, per-card scheduling, bidirectional study
- flashcard_sets, flashcard_cards, flashcard_progress tables
- Generate from worksheet vocabulary or manual creation
- Key: useFlashcardLearning, translate-flashcard, FlashcardsLearning page
- RAG: flashcards, spaced repetition, vocabulary retention

### Welcome Test & Learning Paths
- 49 questions, 5 skill areas (grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, speaking)
- 4 Learning Paths: Comfort, Guided, Accelerated, Target (15 signals)
- Result: student_learning_profiles with CEFR estimate + radar chart
- Key: useWelcomeTest, process-welcome-test, WelcomeTestPage
- RAG: placement test, level assessment, CEFR test

### DSLM (Dynamic Student Learning Model)
- 4-layer: Events → Metrics → Profiles → Decisions
- Nano-skill format: "B1.grammar.present_perfect.negative"
- Trend detection: improving, stable, declining
- student_events, student_learning_elements, future_worksheet_suggestions tables
- Key: useStudentEvents (dslm/), useSkillMetrics, generate-timeline
- RAG: progress tracking, nano-skill, mastery, learning analytics

### Student Hub Portal
- Email-first portal at /my/:teacherToken, 30-day localStorage session
- Dashboard, flashcards, homework, worksheets, lessons, settings
- Student GCal sync with per-status colors and sync toggles
- Key: get-student-hub-data, useStudentHubData, StudentHub* pages
- RAG: student portal, student dashboard, self-study

### Lesson Calendar & Booking
- Teacher calendar with realtime subscription on calendar_slots
- Statuses: available, booked, pending, completed, no_show, needs_review, deleted
- Public booking page via public_calendar_slug
- Weekly recurring via calendar_recurrence_rules
- GCal teacher: gcal-sync (upsert/delete/cancel/create_permanent_room)
- GCal student: student-gcal-sync (per-status colors, sync toggles)
- Meeting links: GCal-only model, ghost event → hangoutLink extraction
- Reschedule: student initiates → teacher confirm/reject → GCal sync both sides
- Bulk Actions: batch confirm/reject/complete/no-show with GCal sync
- Recurring Booking Modal: selective confirm/reject with checkboxes
- Realtime: teacher subscription, student subscription + 5s polling, scrollToToday once (hasScrolledRef)
- Key: useCalendarSlots, CalendarPage, SlotDetailModal, RecurringBookingModal, calendar-handle-reschedule-decision
- RAG: lesson calendar, booking, Google Calendar, Google Meet, recurring, reschedule, meeting link

### Token & Subscription System
- Stripe: Free (2 tokens), Side-Gig ($9/15mo), Full-Time ($19/30mo), Pro ($79/90mo)
- Token flow: monthly allowance → purchased tokens → rollover tokens
- Rollover: unused monthly → rollover at cycle end
- Key: useTokenSystem, usePlanLogic, create-subscription, stripe-webhook
- RAG: pricing, subscription, Stripe, tokens

### Interactive Worksheets & Live Sessions
- Shareable permanent links (/shared/:token), interactive student mode
- Live Session: realtime answer monitoring, up to 12 exercises, nano-skill mastery ratings
- Drawing canvas overlay for annotation
- Key: useInteractiveSharedWorksheet, useLiveSessionAnswers, useDrawingCanvas
- RAG: interactive worksheet, live session, real-time, sharing

### Student Management
- Student profiles with knowledge entries (strengths, weaknesses, interests, goals)
- Knowledge entries injected into AI worksheet generation prompts
- Key: useStudents, useStudentKnowledge, StudentPage
- RAG: student profile, personalization, knowledge base

### Download System
- HTML/PDF export, optional payment for non-subscribers
- Key: useDownloadStatus, upload-to-r2, create-export-payment
- RAG: worksheet download, PDF export

### Admin Dashboard
- User stats, impersonation (admin-impersonate), activity log
- Key: AdminDashboardPage, AdminImpersonationBanner
- RAG: admin, user management

### SEO Infrastructure
- 70+ static HTML landing pages (grammar, topics, audience, CEFR, comparisons)
- 65+ blog articles (React index + static HTML)
- Structured data: SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, WebSite, BreadcrumbList
- AI discovery: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, llms-answers.txt, openapi.yaml, knowledge-graph.json, ai-plugin.json
- sitemap.xml (510 URLs), robots.txt (15+ AI bots)
- Key: Index.tsx, About, Pricing, HowItWorks, ExerciseTypes, Prompts, Glossary, Resources, Blog
- RAG: SEO, landing pages, blog, structured data, AI discovery

## Edge Functions (49 total)
generateWorksheet, generate-audio, generate-image, transcribe-audio, verify-open-answers, process-pending-ai-evaluations, process-welcome-test, generate-welcome-test-audio, generate-timeline, track-student-event, track-user-event, send-homework-email, send-homework-reminders, send-flashcard-email, send-test-email, send-worksheet-email, send-calendar-notification-email, translate-flashcard, get-student-hub-data, get-student-bookings, find-teachers-by-student-email, gcal-auth-start, gcal-auth-callback, gcal-sync, student-gcal-auth-start, student-gcal-auth-callback, student-gcal-sync, calendar-handle-reschedule-decision, calendar-export-csv, create-subscription, stripe-webhook, check-subscription-status, customer-portal, downgrade-subscription, finalize-upgrade, create-export-payment, verify-export-payment, upload-to-r2, add-tokens, admin-impersonate, add-rls-policies, delete-account, cleanup-anonymous-users, notify-generation-failure, submitFeedback, test-send-reminder, test-webhook
